title: Mandatory Measures to Warn Pedestrians of Approaching Cyclists or PMDs
what_it_is: Mandatory Measures to Warn Pedestrians of Approaching Cyclists or PMDs

sections.label: Rider visibility laser light suggestion
sections.summary: The purpose is to increase rider visibility to other path users, and the practicality and effectiveness of laser lights will be studied, considering costs and safety.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The purpose is to increase visibility of the rider to other path users.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We will study the practicality and effectiveness of the suggestion of using laser lights, bearing in mind the costs and safety implications.

sections.label: Laser light risk to path users
sections.summary: There is no conclusive study on laser projection lights' visibility and effectiveness, and the Class 3A or 3R laser risks harming path users, especially children.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: First, there really has not been any conclusive study about laser projection lights' visibility and effectiveness on shared paths and footpaths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As we know, the laser beam is a Class 3A or 3R laser.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: There is a certain element of risk when it is shone into the eye.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This could potentially harm path users, especially children, who may be at that particular eye level with the laser projection.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will definitely look at the suggestion and see whether it is, indeed, effective and worth implementing.
